categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yida Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical industry focusing on the production and sales of glycol ethers and glycol ether esters, propylene oxide, hydrogen peroxide, and related chemical products. The company also produces automotive brake fluids and high-performance new materials such as active alumina. Its business includes upstream raw material production, midstream chemical manufacturing, and downstream specialty chemical applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced proprietary technologies including flexible production techniques for glycol ethers and esters, and a patented HPPO (Hydrogen Peroxide to Propylene Oxide) direct oxidation process for propylene oxide production. It has developed molecular sieve catalysts and integrated reaction systems that improve safety, efficiency, and environmental performance. The company also employs flow bed hydrogen peroxide technology for hydrogen peroxide production and invests in R&D collaborations with universities for continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in coatings, electronics, inks, automotive, paper manufacturing, and chemical intermediates. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying major chemical companies and industrial clients. It is integrated into the supply chains of global chemical giants such as BASF and Dow, providing specialty solvents and raw materials for polyurethane and semiconductor sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production facilities in Jiangsu (including Jiangyin, Taixing), Jilin, Zhuhai, and Shanghai. It serves primarily the domestic Chinese market, which accounts for over 95% of its revenue, with a smaller portion of exports to international markets. The company leverages strategic locations near raw material sources and ports to optimize logistics and expand global trade.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yida Chemical operates across multiple points in the chemical supply chain, including upstream production of key raw materials like propylene oxide, midstream manufacturing of glycol ethers and esters, and downstream specialty chemical products such as electronic-grade chemicals and brake fluids. It also extends into chemical warehousing and logistics services, enhancing its downstream supply capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a focus on green, low-carbon, and high-value-added chemical products. R&D priorities include optimizing HPPO technology for propylene oxide, developing high-purity electronic-grade hydrogen peroxide, and new catalytic materials. It pursues product diversification, flexible manufacturing, and integration of upstream and downstream processes to improve cost efficiency and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including glycol ethers, glycol ether esters, propylene oxide, hydrogen peroxide, and specialty chemicals. The company operates mainly on a product sales model with direct sales to industrial customers. It also earns income from technical services and licensing related to its proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer in the glycol ether and propylene oxide sectors, competing with firms like Denatain, Baichuan, and Sanmu Group in China. Globally, it competes indirectly with major chemical giants such as Dow, BASF, Shell, and LyondellBasell, especially in propylene oxide production. Jiangsu Yida positions itself as a technology innovator and standard setter in the Chinese fine chemical industry with a strong emphasis on green and flexible production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.77 billion, a slight decrease of 2.55% from the previous year, but achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.53 million, reversing prior losses. Its production capacity utilization rates are high, especially for glycol ether products (over 92%). The company has shown strong cash flow growth and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technological upgrades, indicating a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yida Chemical differentiates itself through its proprietary flexible production technology allowing rapid adjustment to market demands and product specifications. It is a national standard setter for glycol ether products and offers high-quality, environmentally friendly chemical products with stable supply ensured by upstream raw material production. The company integrates upstream and downstream processes to improve cost efficiency and product margins, and it leverages strategic geographic positioning and partnerships with global chemical leaders to enhance competitiveness.
